claims.evidence: The witness report confirms two road bicycles are present (one black, one white).
The witness saw the bicycles but did not provide details on the cleanliness of the drivetrain or frame surfaces.
Affordability is subjective and depends on the final price list comparison.

risks.risk: The 'Yamaha' branding may be aftermarket stickers on generic frames.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number stamped under the bottom bracket.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic, unbranded road bicycles.

risks.risk: Seized or non-functional gear shifters and brake calipers.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the gears shifting through the full range and brakes engaging.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a complete mechanical overhaul.

risks.risk: Structural cracks or poor repairs hidden by the paint on the frame.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame welds and the area around the bottom bracket.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having frame damage/scrap value.

risks.risk: Worn out drivetrain (chain and cassette) requiring immediate replacement.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rear cassette teeth and chain side-profile.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing a new drivetrain.

proof_requests: Photo of the serial numbers located under the crank area.
Video of the wheels spinning to check for trueness and bearing noise.
Video of the gear shifters being operated.
Close-up photos of the tire sidewalls to check for dry rot.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the items as road bicycles and confirmed the quantity, allowing for a baseline valuation at the worst-case mechanical condition.
